release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.3.9 — Authentic NCERT Curriculum Question Bank & Apple Design System:
• 100% Authentic NCERT MCQs: 2,480 verified curriculum questions across 124 syllabus topics (Classes 5-12 & Olympiad) with 1,240 descriptive bank items safely held in backend registry.
• 3-Question Focus Sprint Enforced: Answering 1 question does not unlock; students must solve 3 consecutive curriculum questions to earn app unlock credits.
• Accurate App Block Title: Displays '{AppName} Blocked' (e.g. Instagram Blocked, YouTube Blocked) instead of 'android Paused'.
• Panoramic Welcome Animation: Logo and brand typography glide in simultaneously with refined wider horizontal medallion squircle (148x86 outer shell, 126x66 inner frame).
• Purged All Bitcoin / Crypto Emblems: Replaced with Apple-grade Sparkles, Trophy, and concentric squircle medals; renamed tab to Rewards.
• Zero Mock Data: Removed hardcoded strings across Student Profile, Parent Dashboard, and Progress analytics; synchronized with real Supabase backend + offline caching.
• Autofill Highlight Neutralized: Native styles.xml and transparent input wells eliminate yellow background boxes on email/login fields.
• Preloaded High-Speed AI: Integrated Groq Qwen 27B engine with zero user API key setup required.
• Permanent JWT Persistence: Preserves login sessions across app restarts.
